goal: Produce a publishable 60-second cinematic explainer showing why AI inference is moving toward edge devices.
audience: Technology-curious viewers aged 20-40 who understand consumer technology but do not know chip architecture.

content_contract.editorial_question: What changes when inference moves from centralized cloud systems to devices near the user?
content_contract.audience_promise: Explain the trade-offs through one clear story rather than a list of buzzwords.

craft_contract.visual_direction: Cinematic, tactile, high-contrast but readable; abstract mechanisms should have spatial cause and effect.
craft_contract.audio_direction: Narration, music, sound effects and deliberate silence are designed as one timeline.
craft_contract.editing_direction: Clear opening promise, escalating mechanism, concise payoff; no filler shots.

hard_constraints: Factual chip and performance claims require sources.
Do not imply synthetic product footage is real product evidence.
preferences: Use hybrid production methods where they improve clarity or craft.
unknowns: Final platform disclosure settings must be checked at upload.
success_criteria: The argument is understandable on a first watch.
The actual final media passes technical QA and independent craft review.
